source: https://www.evisa.gov.et/visa and https://www.evisa.gov.et/information/tourist, read 2026-08-30. The public React application renders the visa, arrival, Ethiopia address, personal, passport and upload field labels and states JPEG/JPG/PNG for photo and passport copy. It publishes no readable regexes, character limits or official validation error strings, so no pattern key is used, no [[errors]] array is published and no local validator is mounted.

visa_route.label: Visa route
visa_route.help: Check the official exemption and visa-on-arrival page before choosing the paid online Tourist Visa.

visa_duration.label: Tourist Visa duration
visa_duration.help: The tourist page lists USD 62 for a 30-day single-entry visa and USD 152 for a 90-day single-entry visa.

arrival_date.label: Arrival Date
arrival_date.placeholder: Select in the official date control
arrival_date.help: The eVisa validity starts from the intended entry date entered in the application. The page publishes no text date pattern.

departure_country.label: Departure Country and City
departure_country.help: The arrival-information section asks for the departure country and city, airline and flight number.

address_in_ethiopia.label: Address in Ethiopia
address_in_ethiopia.placeholder: Accommodation name, city, street and phone
address_in_ethiopia.help: The application asks for accommodation type, name, city, street address and telephone.

given_name.label: Given Name
given_name.help: Copy the given name from the passport used for the application. The page publishes no character limit.

surname.label: Surname
surname.help: Copy the surname from the passport used for the application. The page publishes no character limit.

citizenship.label: Citizenship
citizenship.help: Multiple nationals should choose citizenship according to the passport they intend to use for travel.

date_of_birth.label: Date of Birth
date_of_birth.placeholder: Select in the official date control
date_of_birth.help: Match the passport. The public page publishes no text date pattern.

email.label: Email Address
email.help: The personal-information section asks for email and email confirmation. Use an address you can check for the decision.

passport_number.label: Passport Number
passport_number.help: Use the passport that will be carried for entry. The public page publishes no passport-number pattern or length.

passport_expiry.label: Passport Expiry Date
passport_expiry.placeholder: At least 6 months from intended entry
passport_expiry.help: The tourist page requires the passport to be valid for at least 6 months from the intended entry date.

photo_and_passport_copy.label: Photo and Passport Copy
photo_and_passport_copy.help: A recent passport-size photo and a scanned colour passport copy are mandatory. The public upload note accepts JPEG, JPG and PNG.
